answer: Stake-weighted identity: the registry kernel grants each agent voting power from locked collateral, not from account count. Splitting one wallet into a thousand Sybils buys a thousand bonds yet the same single stake, so influence stays flat while the attacker's cost grows linearly. A bridge of vouchers from elders with locked stake gates newcomers, and a false attestation slashes the backer. Reward nectar is released only after a challenge window, so faking identities forfeits the entire deposit.
